PROPOSAL DOCUMENT

Java AFK NaNo v4.0 Evolution

Next-Generation Feature Concepts, UI/UX Redesign Blueprint & Engine Architecture
Project: Java AFK NaNo
Target: Android (Kotlin JVM)
Date: November 2026
Status: Ready for Review

1. Executive Summary & Product Vision

Java AFK NaNo is an ultra-lightweight, battery-efficient headless Minecraft Java Edition client designed specifically for mobile Android devices. It connects directly to Minecraft servers (protocols 1.8 through 1.21.4+), authenticates, handles network protocol keep-alives, and maintains long-running AFK sessions using a foreground Android service.

The core philosophy of the application is the "NaNo" standard:

  • Sub-3 MB APK Size: Pure Kotlin/JVM with zero WebView, Chromium, or JNI rendering baggage.
  • Near-Zero Battery Impact: Consumes <0.5% battery over an 8-hour overnight AFK session.
  • Pure Headless Protocol: Receives only network frames; never renders expensive 3D voxels.

The v4.0 upgrade aims to elevate Java AFK NaNo from a simple connection tool into an intelligent, self-preserving Minecraft companion with visual world cues, anti-detection behavior, and survival safeguards.

2. UX & UI Areas Requiring Redesign

1. Server Cards (Home Screen)

Current Issue: Cards are static. You cannot tell if a server is online or what its latency is without entering the session.

v4.0 Redesign:

  • Live Ping Pill: Displays TCP latency (e.g., 24ms) and player count (18/50).
  • 1-Tap Card Toggle: Instant Connect/Disconnect power button right on the card.
  • MOTD Strip: Single-line server announcement preview.
  • Pulsing Alive Indicator: Retains smooth 2s breathing glow ring for online bots.
2. Session Screen HUD

Current Issue: Top status card occupies 40% of the screen height, squeezing logs/chat into a tiny scrollable area.

v4.0 Redesign:

  • Minecraft Hearts HUD: 10 authentic pixel-perfect red hearts & 10 food drumsticks.
  • Compact Metrics: 3-column chip row for Coordinates, AFK Time, and Data Usage.
  • Expanded Chat Space: 75% of screen allocated to streaming chat and logs.
3. Quick Macro Chips Bar

Current Issue: Executing frequent commands (/afk, /spawn, /home) requires opening the soft keyboard and typing manually every time.

v4.0 Redesign: Horizontally scrolling chips directly above the input box for 1-tap command execution.

4. Segmented Settings Sheet

Current Issue: Monolithic scroll dialog with raw text inputs.

v4.0 Redesign: Clean Material 3 Modal Bottom Sheet organized into 3 clear tabs: Connection, AFK Automation, and Survival & Safety.

3. Comprehensive 16-Feature Proposal Matrix

🛡️ Pillar 1: Pro AFK Behaviors & Survival Guard

1. Natural Camera Swivel (Yaw/Pitch Oscillation)
Anti-AFK Effort: Low
Gently rotates the bot's camera angle by ±5° to ±18° with randomized intervals (every 12–28 seconds). Fools advanced anti-cheat plugins (Vulcan, GrimAC, Matrix) looking for static robotic angles. Network cost: 1 tiny packet (12 bytes) every 20 seconds; 0% battery impact.
2. Auto-Eat & Starvation Guard
Survival Effort: Medium
Reads live food packets (food = r.readVarInt()). When hunger drops below 14 (7 drumsticks), the bot automatically sends an interaction packet on the hotbar food slot to eat, preventing starvation deaths while AFK at mob farms.
3. Sneak / Un-sneak Micro-Pulse
Social Effort: Low
Transmits an ENTITY_ACTION packet (sneak for 400ms, then stand) periodically. Visually signals to other players on the server that the bot account is alive.
4. Emergency Disconnect on Damage
Safety Effort: Low
Configurable threshold (e.g., < 4 hearts): If the bot takes damage from lava, suffocating blocks, or hostile mobs, it cleanly disconnects to preserve equipment and inventory.

🎮 Pillar 2: Visual HUD & Chat Superpowers

5. Authentic Minecraft Hearts & Food Drumsticks HUD
HUD Effort: Low
Renders 10 red hearts and 10 food drumsticks in Jetpack Compose, updating dynamically whenever PLAY_S2C_UPDATE_HEALTH is received.
6. Quick Command Macro Chips Bar
Chat Effort: Low
Horizontally scrolling chips (/afk, /spawn, /home, /repair, /heal, /tpa yes) above the chat input box for instant execution.
7. Minecraft Color-Coded Chat (§ Formatting)
Visual Effort: Medium
Converts standard Minecraft section formatting codes (§a green, §c red, §6 gold, §l bold) into Compose AnnotatedString for authentic in-game chat reading.
8. Live XYZ Coordinates & Cardinal Compass
HUD Effort: Low
Displays current coordinates (e.g. 124, 68, -312) and cardinal orientation (North/South/East/West) parsed from player position packets.

🔔 Pillar 3: Background Reliability, Reconnects & Alerts

9. Intelligent Server Restart Grace Period
Reliability Effort: Low
When a disconnect reason matches "Restarting" or "Rebooting", the client enters a 45–60s grace delay instead of immediate rapid reconnect backoff, preventing connection firewall bans.
10. Chat Mention & Direct Message Push Notifications
Alerts Effort: Medium
Vibrates the phone and posts an Android heads-up notification when your username is mentioned or someone whispers via /msg.
11. Notification Action Buttons ([Stop All], [Reconnect])
System Effort: Low
Interactive action buttons attached directly to the ongoing Android foreground service notification.
12. Night AFK Scheduled Window
Automation Effort: Medium
Allows scheduling connection windows (e.g. 11:30 PM to 6:30 AM) to save battery and mobile data.

🧰 Pillar 4: Multi-Bot Management & Presets

13. JSON & QR Code Server Config Backup/Share
Utility Effort: Low
Export configured servers and command macros to clipboard JSON or share with a friend via a QR code.
14. 1-Tap Popular Server Presets
Presets Effort: Low
Instant presets for Hypixel, 2b2t, DonutSMP, and Aternos with automated protocol detection.
15. Batch Master Actions (Start All / Stop All)
Batch Effort: Low
Master controls in the drawer or top bar to connect or disconnect all configured bots in sequence.
16. Per-Server Custom Accent Color & Tags
Customization Effort: Low
Tag servers (e.g. SMP, Anarchy, Hub) with custom badges for visual clarity.
